explanation: A real npj Genomic Medicine article exists in 2017, volume 2, article 13, with a substantially matching title and DOI 10.1038/s41525-017-0012-9. However, its authors are Carmona, Accomando, Binder, et al., not Kaushal A et al., so the citation has a major author mismatch.
mismatches: authors: claimed Kaushal A et al., actual Carmona JJ, Accomando WP Jr, Binder AM et al.
title: claimed abbreviated title, actual title is "Empirical comparison of reduced representation bisulfite sequencing and Infinium BeadChip reproducibility and coverage of DNA methylation in humans"
search_attempts: web searched: "Empirical comparison of RRBS and Infinium BeadChip"
